NEKO_MEMBER_MULTIUSER_USER_PASSWORD.description: Password for viewers. Share it with the people you watch with - they join with any display name.

NEKO_MEMBER_MULTIUSER_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password: same login, but can take control from anyone, kick and lock the room. Keep it to yourself.

NEKO_IMAGE.description: The app to stream. Swap firefox for chromium, brave, google-chrome, microsoft-edge, vivaldi, tor-browser, xfce, kde or vlc and redeploy.

NEKO_DESKTOP_SCREEN.description: Stream resolution and frame rate. 1920x1080@30 looks sharper but costs more CPU and bandwidth.

NEKO_MEMBER_PROVIDER.description: Login mode: one shared viewer password plus one admin password. Leave as is.

PORT.description: Port of the neko web client behind the Railway domain - leave as is.
